def build_ip_lookup_kql(ips, lookback_days=7):
    ip_list = ", ".join(f"'{ip}'" for ip in ips)
    return f"""
    let watch_ips = dynamic([{ip_list}]);
    CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago({lookback_days}d)
    | where SourceIP in (watch_ips) or DestinationIP in (watch_ips)
    """
caption: A dynamic([...]) array is KQL's parameterized IN clause — one round trip, every IOC checked.

steps.label: chunked(ips, 5000)
